triples.tail_surface: redundant design based on double failure criteria
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 基于双重故障准则的冗余设计
triples.evidence_text: The shaft seal is to be of redundant design based on double failure criteria.

triples.tail_surface: Bearing lifetime calculation in accordance with ISO 281
triples.evidence_text: Bearing lifetime calculation in accordance with ISO 281 is to be submitted for review.

triples.tail_surface: provided with at least two lubricating oil pumps
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 配备至少两台润滑油泵
triples.evidence_text: Each pressurized lubricating oil system, essential for operation of the pod propulsor,is to be provided with at least two lubricating oil pumps.

triples.head_surface: lubricating oil pump for normal service being out of service
triples.head_canonical_zh: 正常服务润滑油泵失效
triples.tail_surface: one or more independently driven standby pumps may be provided
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 提供一台或多台独立驱动的备用泵
triples.evidence_text: For multiple pod propulsor unit installation, one or more independently driven standby pumps may be provided such that all units can be operated at rated power in the event of any one lubricating oil pump for normal service being out of service.
